description: Sort a project's problems into categories now instead of waiting for the next test batch, as the Problems page's sort buttons do. scope unsorted (the default) sorts the problems no category holds yet and returns what moved; use it after create_custom_check so earlier problems move into the new check. scope unsolved or solved sorts every problem on that tab again and writes fresh fixes; it runs in the background for a few minutes, after which list_problem_categories shows the result. Uses the model and a daily allowance per project.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

scope.description: unsorted: sort the problems no category holds yet, now (Sort Unsorted Problems). unsolved or solved: sort every problem on that tab of the Problems page again, into new categories where that is more accurate; runs in the background.
scope.title: Scope

name: sort_problems
